module_summary: Serial sequence detector: a 3-bit state register advanced by the sd_route next-state block, asserting sequence_detected when state equals the match code.

anchors.name: ph_r

anchors.name: sequence_detected
anchors.why: FSM-decoded output: high when state equals Q_MATCH.
